mapper.select: SELECT user_id, pwd, user_sttus_cd, access_limit_yn, login_chk_cnt, pwd_chg_yn, pwd_chg_dt FROM msf_user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT msf_user_info.user_id, msf_user_info.pwd, msf_user_info.user_sttus_cd, msf_user_info.access_limit_yn, msf_user_info.login_chk_cnt, msf_user_info.pwd_chg_yn, msf_user_info.pwd_chg_dt FROM msf_user_info INNER JOIN msf_usr_app_info ON msf_user_info.user_id = msf_usr_app_info.user_id WHERE msf_usr_app_info.uuid = #{deviceUuid} AND msf_usr_app_info.apv_sttus_cd = 'A'

SELECT user_id, user_nm, mobile_no, agent_cd, shop_cd, ( SELECT apv_sttus_cd FROM msf_usr_app_info WHERE msf_usr_app_info.user_id = msf_user_info.user_id ORDER BY last_access_dt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) AS apv_sttus_cd FROM msf_user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT msf_user_info.user_id, msf_user_info.user_nm, msf_user_info.mobile_no, msf_user_info.agent_cd, msf_user_info.shop_cd, msf_usr_app_info.apv_sttus_cd FROM msf_user_info LEFT JOIN msf_usr_app_info ON msf_user_info.user_id = msf_usr_app_info.user_id AND msf_usr_app_info.uuid = #{deviceUuid} WHERE msf_user_info.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO msf_user_hst ( user_id, user_nm, pwd, agent_cd, shop_cd, mobile_no, ip, email_adr, email_receive_yn, user_sttus_cd, access_limit_yn, access_limit_dt, login_chk_cnt, pwd_chg_yn, pwd_chg_dt, chg_dt ) SELECT user_id, user_nm, pwd, COALESCE(agent_cd, 'NONE'), shop_cd, mobile_no, ip, email_adr, email_receive_yn, user_sttus_cd, access_limit_yn, access_limit_dt, login_chk_cnt, pwd_chg_yn, pwd_chg_dt, chg_dt FROM msf_user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE msf_user_info SET chg_dt = now(), login_chk_cnt = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE msf_user_info SET pwd = #{encodedPassword}, pwd_chg_dt = now(), pwd_chg_yn = 'Y' WHERE user_id = #{userId}
